lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgTi8Fe4O16 (MgTi4(FeO4)2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2 (No. 5), with 32 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 9 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis identifies Fe and Ti centers as octahedral, each with six O neighbors, while Mg adopts an 8-vertex environment. Polyhedral sharing includes corner- and edge-sharing between Fe and Ti octahedra, and corner-sharing between Fe octahedra, forming a three-dimensional periodic connectivity network.
